Execution Status

  • CURIE: gmeow:ExecutionStatus
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ExecutionStatus
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/procedures
  • Box roles: TBox role (What is this?)

The status of an Execution occurrence — a VALUE, never a subclass. The set is open; new statuses are fresh individuals.

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:ExecutionStatus as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
